name: Zombie Z
tagline: Every round both sides evolve: spend virus score on random mutations and grow stronger.
summary: Zombie Z is a zombie infection mode (released September 2018) in which humans and zombies level up during the match. Players earn a virus score in battle and spend it on mutations that grant random powers; level unlocks zombie classes and human weapons. Since December 2021 a Competitive Rule variant runs 13 rounds of 3 minutes for up to 32 players, with AI participants and doubled Karma rewards.
description: The wiki's in-game blurb: every round evolving zombie and human abilities - earn a virus score through battle, spend it to mutate, and each mutation grants a random power. Humans must survive the zombie attacks or kill all zombies before time runs out; zombies must infect all humans. Level (max 40 since July 2021, previously 30) determines which zombie classes and weapons are available; random weapon purchases only show level-appropriate options and damage numbers are displayed on hit. Humans start with a Battle Glock instead of the USP. Mutations can convert the flashbang into a Liquid-Nitrogen Grenade that freezes zombies and the smoke grenade into a Vaccine Grenade whose blue mist damages zombies. Competitive maps: Italy, Assault, Estate, Falls, Dust, Cargo Ship.
rules: Humans win by surviving or killing all zombies; zombies win by infecting all humans.
Virus score earned in battle is spent on mutations granting random powers.
Level gates zombie classes and human weapon choices (max level 40).
Competitive Rule: 13 rounds x 3 minutes, up to 32 players, rooms cannot be password-locked, AI players fill in, Karma doubled.
Zombie Heroes appear randomly once all zombies are unlocked.
trivia: Competitive Rule system introduced in December 2021 in South Korea.
Season Pass weapons receive enhancements in this mode.
